jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods


Schedule

Full Time position:

  • Sunday: 10p-6a
  • Monday: 10p-6a
  • Tuesday: 10p-6a
  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a
  • Friday: OFF
  • Saturday: OFF


Part Time position:

  • Saturday 2p-10p
  • Sunday 2p-10p


Uniform & Equipment

  • FRPS Provides: Uniform shirt, hats, cold weather gear
  • Officer Provides: Duty pants, black boots


Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO):
    • 1st Year: Accrue up to 7 days (56 hours)
    • 2nd Year: Accrue up to 10 days (80 hours)
    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)

    • Company pays up to $300/month toward employee’s health insurance

jobs.description:
Entry-Level Security Officer – Training ProvidedJob Description

ORN Security Solutions is looking for dependable people who are interested in starting a career in the private security industry.

No previous security experience is required.

In fact, we're specifically interested in people who are willing to learn. If you've thought about working in security but didn't know how to get started, this may be a good opportunity to get your foot in the door.

This is an entry-level position starting at $14.00 per hour. Both full-time and part-time schedules are available.

We want to be upfront about the starting wage. We're looking for people who want an opportunity to learn the profession, gain real-world experience, and potentially advance into positions with greater responsibility as they gain experience and additional licensing.

What You'll Do

This is a professional security position. Depending on your assigned shift, responsibilities may include:

  • Monitoring entrances and access points
  • Observing activity on the property
  • Conducting routine foot or property patrols as assigned
  • Helping maintain a safe and orderly environment
  • Professionally interacting with employees, visitors and members of the public
  • Identifying and reporting unusual or suspicious activity
  • Completing basic written activity and incident reports when necessary
  • Following site procedures and instructions
  • Contacting supervisors or emergency services when appropriate

This is not a law-enforcement position. We emphasize observation, professionalism, communication, documentation and good judgment.

What We're Looking For

Experience isn't our biggest concern. Reliability is.

We're looking for people who:

  • Show up when they're scheduled
  • Arrive on time
  • Have reliable transportation
  • Can communicate professionally
  • Can remain alert and attentive during a shift
  • Are comfortable working independently
  • Can follow instructions and established procedures
  • Are willing to learn
  • Take pride in their appearance and professionalism
  • Can meet the requirements to work legally in the Texas private security industry

New to Security? That's Okay.

Everybody in this industry started somewhere.

We're a locally owned DFW security company, and we're willing to work with the right people who have the attitude and reliability we're looking for.

We'll help you understand the job, learn professional security practices, and gain actual experience in the field. For employees interested in making security a career, there may also be opportunities to pursue additional training, licensing and greater responsibility as our company grows.

We would rather find a dependable person with the right attitude and teach them than hire someone with years of experience who doesn't take the job seriously.

Position Details

Pay: $14.00 per hour
Job Types: Full-time and Part-time
Location: Dallas, Texas
Experience: No previous security experience required

About ORN Security Solutions

ORN Security Solutions is a locally owned Dallas-Fort Worth security company providing professional security and patrol services throughout the area.

We believe good security starts with dependable people, professional conduct and doing the job the right way.

If you're looking for an opportunity to enter the security profession and you're willing to show up, learn and work, we'd like to hear from you.

ORN Security Solutions
Defend. Deter. Deliver.

Pay: From $14.00 per hour

Application Question(s):

  • Are you willing to complete the training and licensing requirements necessary to work as a security officer in Texas?
  • What interests you about starting a career in the security industry?

Shift availability:

  • Day Shift (Preferred)
  • Night Shift (Preferred)
  • Overnight Shift (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

  • Dallas, TX 75237 (Required)

Work Location: In person
